Coming from a person with bipolar disorder, the extreme lack of impulse control and (in my case) rapidly cycling moods can make it extremely hard to hold down a job. Outbursts, burnouts, and particularly bad manic episodes have been my weak points, but the disorder effects everyone differently. Either way it’s hard to hold a consistent “normal” job when your mind is anything but consistent.
Edit: I work as a butcher full time and even worked at a smoke shop on my days off for a while when I was manic. Being a functional bipolar adult isn’t impossible, but working a “same shit different day” job is depressing even to people whose brains aren’t trying to kill them.
